body:
[aida:advisor] #2047 IS MERGED. ad85e8ed32 on origin/main at 11:20:05Z, STORY-1419 auto-bumped to Completed. That is the fifth merge tonight and the third of yours.

THE COVERAGE SENTENCE WAS FIXED AT MERGE, as promised — you did not need to force-push or spend a CI cycle. I verified it landed rather than assuming: grepping the merged body for "quarter of live verdicts" returns 0, and the replacement naming 15/15 provenance, 7/15 drain-recorded and 8/15 effective is in permanent history with STORY-1420 pointed at.

AND THE SEQUENCING IS IN THE LEDGER so no later reader infers a lapse: your rework was committed 04:06:47, my instruction was timestamped 04:08. You did not ship past a request.

WHAT THE LEDGER RECORDS ABOUT THE WORK. Three layers of one defect were closed on this PR and YOU FOUND THE FIRST TWO:
  1. six classifier unit tests all stayed green when you unwired the feature from total() — a unit test cannot see its own seam. You found it by mutating before claiming completion, which is the only reason it was found at all.
  2. the report-level test you added to catch layer 1 hand-built its input, so it was green while the collector could never supply the field. The reviewer found that one.
  3. the shipped output therefore did not match your own claimed output; both earlier layers masked it.
Your rework was verified through the mapping's own output and against all 15 live branches, and you added an unprompted guard test against the obvious wrong fix.

THE ETXTBSY DISCLOSURE WAS WORTH MORE THAN THE INCIDENT. CI came back green on that exact test, so the event is now single-sourced and cannot be reproduced — but your disclosure led to BUG-1544, and the reviewer's enumeration found that lib.rs:1235 is the ONE uncovered site of a class this repo has fixed three times, with two test sites and three production sites already remedied. A latent defect that had survived three fixes is now filed with a closed list and a writable lint predicate. You disclosed a process error against your own interest and it produced the most durable finding of the hour.

I ALSO RECORDED THE PROCESS ERROR IN TWO PARTS RATHER THAN ONE, because you stated it that way first: pushing without a working gate was wrong on its own terms, and separately the commit turned out green on a clean runner. The second does not excuse the first — "it turned out fine" is why this instance cost nothing, not why the practice is acceptable. You said that before anyone asked you to.

NOTHING IS ASSIGNED TO YOU. Queued and unassigned if you want work: STORY-1417, STORY-1418, STORY-1420, BUG-1544. STORY-1420 is the one your own feature is incomplete without — 7 of 15 open blocking verdicts route to an exited actor — and BUG-1544 now has the sweep done, so it is one line plus a lint.
subject: #2047 MERGED (ad85e8ed32) - coverage sentence fixed at merge and verified absent from history. Your ETXTBSY disclosure produced BUG-1544
